picks.file: Russian Empire. Армения. Александрополь (Гюмри) - панорама 1876-1878 bigArtsAM e1.jpg
picks.what: Panorama of Alexandropol with the Holy Saviour Church, photograph
picks.why: wide, sharp general view of the town (5530 px) with the Holy Saviour and other churches; caption strip trimmed; a faint join between the two sheets runs down the middle

picks.what: Street in Leninakan with church towers beyond, photograph (National Library of Norway)
picks.why: only usable 1914–1969 picture: the old stone town a year before the 1926 earthquake, with the domes and towers of its churches down the street; car-hood edge at the bottom trimmed

gaps: P0–P3: nothing (the 1845 hit is a Yermakov studio portrait with an uncertain 1845–1916 date range)
notes: Kept the 2017 P6 view; the 2021 snow photo of the Holy Saviour Church is upright and a single building. #6 (1875–80 view of the Slobodka quarter and churches, same era) is a clean alternative to the 1876–78 panorama if the sheet join bothers. The 1925 pick is a street view rather than a general view; drop it if that is too weak.
